IncidentBot: :bell: Pager alert 03:07 UTC for svc-errors. On-call: @SRE-Team. Thread opened for comms template discussion.

Priya N: Noticed during last night's rotation that status-page entries had inconsistent section order. Customers saw different formats between updates. Let's standardize.

SRE-Team: Yeah the handoff also missed a brief 'what changed' line. That made follow-ups slow.

Carlos M: I drafted a compact internal template that forces ordering and includes a short 'actions taken' line + 'risk' if applicable. Posting here: 

```text
[INCIDENT] {{incident_id}} | {{service}}
Severity: {{sev}}
Start: {{start_time_iso}} (UTC)
Owners: {{primary}} / {{secondary}}
Short impact: {{impact_short}}

Actions taken so far:
- {{action_1}}
- {{action_2}}

Risk / notes: {{risk_notes}}
Workarounds: {{workaround_short}}
Next ETA: {{next_update_eta}} (UTC)
Postmortem: {{postmortem_link_or_tbd}}
Handoff ready: {{handoff_ready_bool}}
```

Lina (Support): Can we ensure the external template never contains stack traces or internal hostnames? Also include an explicit line for Customer Success to paste into message threads.

Tessa P: External customer blurb idea (two sentences):

"We're investigating an issue affecting {{service}} which may cause errors or slow responses for some customers. Engineers have applied mitigations and are monitoring; we'll share an update by {{next_update_eta}} (UTC)."

Priya N: Good. Guidance on tone: keep neutral, avoid absolutes like 'all users affected' unless verified. Use 'some', 'may', 'potentially' when impact is uncertain. Keep sentences short.

SRE-Team: Suggest validators for IncidentBot before posting status page: check presence of {{incident_id}}, {{sev}}, {{primary}}, {{next_update_eta}}; check that external text length < 800 chars; scan for banned terms list (e.g., hostnames, debug logs).

Carlos M: Also add a small required field 'impact_class' with values: "none", "partial", "major", "outage". This helps CSMs triage.

Lina (Support): For CSM talk-track: one-liner + optional action: 

"Short: We're aware of an issue with {{service}}; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. If you're seeing problems and have SLA coverage, reply with your account ID."

Tessa P: For on-call handoffs, propose a 3-checklist snippet in the template repo README: 1) confirm channel & owners, 2) confirm status page draft exists, 3) confirm next update time set.

Priya N: Can someone add a sample 'Risk' phrasing? We want consistent language when a mitigation may introduce side effects.

SRE-Team: Example risk sentence: "Risk: mitigation involves a configuration change that may cause transient errors for a small fraction of traffic during rollout." Keep it quantitative where possible (<5% etc).

Carlos M: I'll open a PR with the templates + minimal README. I'll include the banned-terms lint rules and the required field list.

Lina (Support): I'll produce the CSM pasteable snippets and a simple FAQ for common customer questions (refunds, SLAs, timelines).

Tessa P: I'll work on adding an IncidentBot pre-publish hook that runs the validators and replies with a checklist result into the thread. If validation fails, IncidentBot should include the missing keys.

IncidentBot: Action created: comms-templates-2150003333 assigned to Carlos M, due 2150080000.

Priya N: Thanks. Small ask: in templates mark which fields are mandatory for external vs internal. That will help automation.

Carlos M: Good call. I'll annotate fields in the PR.

SRE-Team: Plan: ship templates + bot validation before next on-call rotation. If blockers crop up, escalate in this thread.

Priya N: Closing for now; follow PR thread in #devex. :white_check_mark:
